## RgbHelpers.fromHex() method

Build a color from six-digit hexadecimal text such as `#FF8000` (the `#` is optional and case does not matter), converting each 8-bit channel as [RgbHelpers.from8Bit()](./contracts.rgbhelpers.from8bit.md) does.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fromHex(hex: string): Rgb;
```

## Exceptions

`RangeError` when the text is not exactly six hexadecimal digits after an optional `#`<!-- -->. Three-digit and alpha forms are not accepted.
